facts.title: ENHANCE-2 Week 12 FEV1 AUC0–12h
facts.context: Issuer SEC filing states 94 mL placebo-corrected average FEV1 AUC change at Week 12. Does not by itself establish superiority against an active alternative.

facts.title: ENHANCE-1 Week 12 FEV1 AUC0–12h
facts.context: Issuer's prior Phase 3 result. Second NCT belongs to same ensifentrine program, not a second independent ticker opportunity.

facts.title: IMerge 8-week transfusion independence
facts.context: Imetelstat n=118, placebo n=60; primary endpoint. Absolute placebo-adjusted response rate is descriptive, not an RAAS scientific grade.

facts.title: IMerge 24-week transfusion independence
facts.context: Key secondary endpoint, not interchangeable with the 8-week primary outcome.

facts.title: ENVISION complete response at 3 months
facts.context: Single-arm Phase 3 complete response; placebo-adjusted effect cannot be calculated from this result.

facts.title: ENVISION estimated 12-month duration of response
facts.context: Kaplan–Meier DOR estimate only among patients achieving a complete response at 3 months, NOT 82.3% of all enrolled patients.

facts.title: Year-end cash, cash equivalents and marketable securities
